## Description

Enters when price breaks a recent range while ATR or realized volatility expands above a threshold.

## Where it may fit

Volatility transitions from compression to expansion, often around new directional moves.

## Vehicles

Liquid stocks/ETFs, index and commodity futures, FX, crypto.

## Required data

OHLCV bars, rolling range highs/lows, ATR or realized-volatility series.

## Caveats

Breakouts can be false at scheduled news or overnight gaps; test gap fills and stop execution.
